title: GitHub Sponsors Profile Scraper
description: Walks every public GitHub Sponsors profile, oldest listing order first, and saves each one's login, profile link, bio, and any links found. Remembers where it left off between runs.

githubToken.title: GitHub Personal Access Token (optional)
githubToken.description: Leave this blank to use the token already built into the actor. Only fill this in if you want to run this specific job under a different token. A token with no scopes ticked at all is enough.

pageSize.title: Page Size
pageSize.description: How many profiles to request per page, maximum 100.

maxNewProfiles.title: Maximum New Profiles This Run
maxNewProfiles.description: Stop this run after saving this many new profiles. Use 0 for unlimited.

maxPages.title: Maximum Pages This Run
maxPages.description: Stop this run after fetching this many pages. Use 0 for unlimited.
